briefdescription.para: Increments the number of levels, enforcing a maximum limit.

detaileddescription.para: Increments the value pointed to by nlevels. If the new value exceeds the maximum allowed (MAX_LEVELS), the function returns an error code.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the current number of levels to be incremented.

simplesect.para: SUCCESSFUL (typically 0) if increment is valid; MAX_LEVELS_REACH if the maximum level count is exceeded.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether a given block ID is valid within a YAML file.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the index of the YAML file (read-only).
Pointer to the block ID to validate (read-only).

simplesect.para: true if the block ID is valid, false otherwise.

A block ID is invalid if:
It is less than zero or greater than the number of keys in the file.
Its associated parent name is empty (except for block ID 0).

briefdescription.para: Checks whether a given file ID is valid.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the file ID to validate (read-only).

simplesect.para: true if the file ID is valid, false otherwise.
A file ID is valid if it is between 0 (inclusive) and nfiles (exclusive).
